Connect a WebDAV service such as Nutstore, Nextcloud, ownCloud or a NAS. No separate MCP server is needed. HTTPS with a valid certificate is required.
Use Nutstore address
WebDAV HTTPS address
Allowed folder, relative to this address
Only this folder and its descendants are accessible. / allows the entire configured WebDAV address. The folder must already exist. This does not synchronize an Obsidian vault.
Account / username
Application password
Use a third-party application password when available. Leave blank to keep the saved password only when address and account are unchanged. Credentials stay encrypted in this extension.
Allow this connection to access local-network addresses
Off by default. Enable explicitly for a LAN or VPN NAS. Android 17 also requires its local-network permission. HTTP, invalid certificates, loopback and link-local addresses are not accepted.
Open extension permissions
Check the connection and permissions, then retry deliberately. An interrupted write or export may be incomplete; inspect the destination before repeating it.
Local file transfers

Import through the system picker to authorize a file for upload. Ask Mochi to download a remote file, then save it here. Up to 32 MiB per file, four files and 64 MiB total; staged files expire after one hour and may be evicted by Android. Binary bytes and device paths never enter the model. Enable the transfer Tool separately in Mochi.
